maddeler.e:
نقف (form I)
# نَقُفُّ (naquffu) /na.quf.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of قَفَّ (qaffa)
# نَقُفَّ (naquffa) /na.quf.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of قَفَّ (qaffa)
# نَقُفِّ (naquffi) /na.quf.fi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of قَفَّ (qaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
